description:
FOUND s499h (Opus, 2026-09-27) while probing #2441.  PRE-EXISTING (identical on main da10ea22).

Reproducer (scratch/s499h/p7.pl in the s499h worktree):
    print "a\
    b|\
    c", "\n";
  perl 5.40.3: a<NL>b|<NL>c      PCL: a\<NL>b|\<NL>c

Cause: every dq escape alternation ends in `.` WITHOUT /s -- ExprToCL::_apply_case_escapes (the one-scan decoder since #2441), StringInterpolation::unescape_string and ExprToCL::_take_dq_escape -- so `\` + newline matches no escape and the backslash is kept as text.  perl treats it as an unknown escape: the backslash is dropped.
FIX SHAPE: the three alternations read `.` under /s (rule 11: all three in one commit), then _decode_escape("\n") returns the newline.  Emission change (gen bump); corpus-diff to know the population; guard row in Pl/t/case-invert-01.t beside the #2441 rows.


=== DONE (s499k) ===
Shipped as the task's fix shape, and rule 11 went one step further: the three alternations were COPIES, so they are now ONE `$Pl::ExprToCL::DQ_ESCAPE_RX` (qr, /s) read by _take_dq_escape, _apply_case_escapes and StringInterpolation::unescape_string (through `Pl::ExprToCL::dq_escape_rx()` after a runtime `require` -- Pl/t/string-interp-01.t loads StringInterpolation without ExprToCL, the s438f trap).
Probes = perl 5.40.3: dq, qq{}, <<"E" and <<E heredocs, a \U span, interpolation ("$w\<NL>z"), string eval, s/// replacement literal AND interpolated (the interpolated one was a second wrong spelling on the base), CRLF source, "a\\<NL>b" (two chars), 'a\<NL>b' (unchanged).
Guards: Pl/t/case-invert-01.t rows 23-24, inverse-verified (both FAIL on 937e7b65).  Emission: corpus-diff IDENTICAL 111; the 32-file population with an odd backslash run at a line end + lib = 62 SAME, RCDIFF 0.  Gen v2-2980.  ir-spec §3.2g.
subject: SILENT WRONG (small): a backslash-NEWLINE in a double-quoted string keeps the backslash -- "a\<newline>b" prints a\ + newline + b, perl prints a + newline + b
